scope: Explicitly selected omitted Speed/control sources and relevant self-penalty/immunity boundaries; supplements original 179 without claiming game-wide completeness.

card.name: Veinjammer
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your Bleed
card.effect: After a Bleed tick, choose that victim: Speed reduced 5 ft, minimum 0, and its next concentration save takes-1. Nonstacking; does not remove an Action or prohibit spellcasting.

source.originalText: Veinjammer: Bleeds reduce enemy casting and action speed by 10%.

card.name: Drakestorm Dive
card.rangeAndTarget: Leap up to 60 ft; up to 6 enemies within 15 ft of landing
card.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. DEX save:6d8 chosen damage, half on success. On failure fire applies Burn, cold reduces Speed 10 ft until end next turn, lightning prevents Reactions until then. Land in legal empty space; no additional weapon attack.

source.originalText: Final Flight – Drakestorm Dive: Choose an element and leap into a group, triggering a large AoE blast.

card.name: Elemental Lance
card.effect: Choose fire/cold/lightning. Once/own turn a hit adds S d4 damage; fire adds 1 damage, cold reduces target Speed 5 ft until end next turn, lightning denies opportunity attacks until start its next turn. Nonstacking with Spearcraft; one element rider/turn.

source.originalText: Elemental Lance: Infuse your weapon with elemental energy (fire, ice, or lightning), adding additional damage and effects to your attacks.

card.name: Elemental Bolt
card.effect: Elemental Bolt. Tags: mage-spell, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal S d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire: target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Cold: Speed -10 feet until the end of its next turn. Lightning: one different enemy within 10 feet takes S lightning damage. Secondary damage creates no new spell cast or chain credit.

source.originalText: Elemental Bolt: Cast a bolt of your chosen element (once selected) that deals additional effects based on the element.

card.name: Cold
card.cost: 0; Glacier Spike costs 2 RP when primed
card.duration: Permanent Focus; finisher instantaneous plus slow
card.frequency: Choose at Mage 2; finisher recharge 3 rounds
card.effect: Elemental Focus — Cold. Tags: focus, cold. Once on each of your turns, a natural 19 that hits with a Cold Mage spell is a critical hit. When a Cold Mage spell damages a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, minimum 0. FINISHER — Glacier Spike: after a completed Cold Nuke Chain, Bonus Action, 2 RP. Creatures in a 15-foot cone make Constitution saves, taking (S+1)d8 cold on failure or half on success; failed creatures have their Speed halved until the end of their next turn.

source.originalText: Cold: +5% crit chance, slows targets. Finisher: Glacier Spike – Cone AoE, 50% slow

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: arcanist, focus. Improve the secondary effect of your current Focus. Fire Burns from your Focus cards last one additional turn but never stack. Cold Focus Speed reductions increase by another 5 feet, minimum 0. Lightning Focus's once-per-turn secondary arc increases from S flat lightning damage to S d4 lightning damage. Pivoted Focus uses the corresponding upgraded rider.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Increase the effectiveness of your chosen element's secondary effects.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Elemental Surge. Tags: mage-spell, arcanist, elemental, focus, damage. Make a Mage spell attack. On a hit deal (S+1)d8 + M damage of your current Focus. Fire also applies the Focus Burn; Cold applies the Focus Speed reduction; Lightning applies the Focus secondary arc. This is Focus-eligible and can occupy one slot in a Nuke Chain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Channel a concentrated burst of your chosen element, dealing high damage to a single target.

card.name: Elemental Fusion
card.effect: Elemental Fusion. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, elemental, damage. Choose your current Focus and one other element among Fire, Cold and Lightning. Make a Mage spell attack. On hit deal S d8 of each chosen element. Pair rider: Fire+Cold reduces Speed by 10 feet and applies 1d4 fire at start of target's next turn; Fire+Lightning removes Reaction until start of target's next turn; Cold+Lightning reduces Speed by 10 feet and prevents opportunity attacks until end of target's next turn. For Nuke Chain purposes this spell counts only as your current Focus element.

source.originalText: Elemental Fusion: Combine two elements to create a hybrid spell with unique effects.

card.name: Cascade Storm
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three different creatures within 60 feet
card.effect: Cascade Storm. Tags: mage-spell, elementalist, fire, cold, lightning, damage. Choose up to three creatures. Resolve one separate Mage spell attack against each: first hit deals S d6 fire and 1d4 fire next turn; second hit deals S d6 cold and Speed -10 feet until end next turn; third hit deals S d6 lightning and removes Reaction until start next turn. If fewer than three targets are chosen, unused elements are lost. For Nuke Chain purposes choose one of the three elements before casting; Cascade Storm counts only as that element.

source.originalText: Cascade Storm: Trigger a sequence of elemental effects that build upon each other.

card.name: Elemental Mastery
card.effect: Elemental Mastery. Tags: elementalist, focus, mastery. For 3 rounds, Fire, Cold and Lightning Mage spells all count as matching your current Focus for Nuke Chain eligibility. After you complete one three-distinct-name chain during this duration, you may choose any one of the three Focus finishers when it becomes primed, regardless of your current Focus. Only one finisher may be generated by this use. After that finisher resolves or expires, the mastery continues defensively but cannot prime another off-focus finisher.

source.originalText: Elemental Mastery: Temporarily gain mastery over all elements, allowing you to use any elemental finisher regardless of your focus.

card.name: Undying Spellform
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.effect: Undying Spellform. Tags: lich, undead, death. When damage reduces you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain conscious and able to take Actions until the end of your next regular turn. You remain at 0 HP, cannot benefit from voluntary movement faster than half Speed, and still suffer ordinary consequences of further damage. If still at 0 HP when the effect ends, become unconscious and suffer one failed death save. Healing above 0 ends this feature early.

source.originalText: Undying Spellform: When reduced to 0 HP, continue casting for 1 full round before death.

card.name: Echoing Guard
card.rangeAndTarget: Creature whose attack misses you or whose attack you reduce to 0 damage
card.duration: Until end of that creature's next turn
card.frequency: At most once per attacker per round
card.effect: Echoing Guard. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. When an attack misses you, or one of your defensive techniques reduces the triggering attack to 0 damage, the attacker becomes Staggered: -1 to attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: Echoing Guard: Blocking/dodging applies Stagger (-10% damage, -1 move).

card.name: Pressure Point Strike
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Pressure Point Strike. Tags: arch, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose Arm or Leg: Arm gives -1 on attack rolls; Leg reduces Speed by 10 feet, minimum 0. This represents temporary disruption only and causes no persistent limb injury.

source.originalText: Pressure Point Strike: Target a specific vulnerability in your opponent, potentially disabling a limb or ability temporarily.

card.name: Ledger's Command
card.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
card.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save if hostile or unwilling; willing undead may waive it. On failure you command it for 2 rounds. Once per round as a Bonus Action, command one controlled undead to move up to its Speed and make one ordinary attack, using its own statistics; this obeys the universal one-extra-action limit and all controlled undead share that single Bonus Action command. Controlled undead reduce their first damage each round by 1. Once during the command, one controlled expendable undead may intercept a single-target attack against you and be reduced to 0 HP after absorbing it. This feature creates no corpse, loot or RC farm. Eligible targets are nonlegendary undead of challenge rating no greater than half your Oracle level (round down), with Wisdom saves initially and at each turn end. Commanding uses your shared companion Bonus Action; only one commanded undead makes one attack per round, capped at S d8+M damage with no monster multiattack, recharge or spell resources. Commanding a hostile undead to spend its Action consumes its one hard-denial allowance; later control can only deny Reactions and reduce Speed to 0 on a failed save, never command another Action.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Ledger's Command
value.description: Spend 2 charges: command up to 2 undead within 4 tiles for 2 rounds — each may attack once per round using your Revelation with +10% damage; commanded undead gain +5% DR and one may intercept the next single-target hit meant for you before crumbling (once per command).

card.name: Bones Revelation Mastery
card.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
card.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Marrow Drain: a living target hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Ledger's Command: may target up to 3 undead, but all controlled undead still share one Bonus Action command per round. Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: when its drain resolves, you may always redirect the healing to one ally within 3 tiles of you rather than yourself; its healing cap remains S+M.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 15; Mystery: Bones; Revelation Mastery

value: Enhanced Marrow Drain: also slows target movement by 1 tile
Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: you may redirect drained HP to an ally within 3 tiles

card.name: Tremor Sense
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles for tremor
card.duration: Permanent; tremor penalties until end of your next turn
card.effect: While touching the ground or a structure, you can identify obvious structural instability, hollow spaces and hidden passages within 3 tiles that transmit vibration, subject to ordinary concealment and construction. Reduce the first bludgeoning damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest as an Action, enemies within 2 tiles make Strength saves; on failure they fall Prone, and on success their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of your next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 1; Mystery: Cataclysm

value.name: Tremor Sense
value.description: Passive: detect structural instability and hidden passages within 3 tiles, and +5% resistance to bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, cause a minor tremor — enemies within 2 tiles must save or fall prone; on success they still suffer −1 movement until your next turn.

card.name: Shardburst
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; Speed reduction until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If a failing creature is adjacent to a wall, rubble or substantial stone terrain, it also makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Shardburst
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt stone shards in a 2-tile burst centered on a point within 4 tiles — enemies take 1d6 bludgeoning and suffer −1 movement for 1 round; on a failed save they also fall prone if adjacent to a wall or rubble.

card.name: Gale of Unmaking
card.duration: Damage/movement instantaneous; difficult terrain until start of your next turn
card.effect: Enemies in the line make Strength saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 1 tile on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Failed targets also have Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of their next turn. Mundane exposed flames in the line are extinguished. Loose natural debris in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Gale of Unmaking
value.description: Spend 1 charge: unleash a 4-tile line of forceful wind — enemies in the path take 1d6 bludgeoning, are pushed 1 tile, and suffer −1 movement until your next turn; mundane flames are extinguished and loose debris becomes difficult terrain for 1 round.

card.name: Seal's Fracture
card.effect: Choose Earthquake, Storm or Fire. The zone becomes difficult terrain. At activation and at the start of your next regular turn, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage on failure or half on success: bludgeoning for Earthquake, lightning for Storm, fire for Fire. Until the zone ends, enemies inside take -1 on saving throws against your Cataclysm Revelations; allies inside reduce first damage each round by 1 and cannot be knocked Prone by this zone. Difficult terrain expands 1 tile outward after the second pulse but deals no extra damage there. Structures may crack at Director discretion. When the effect ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 9; Mystery: Cataclysm

value.name: Seal's Fracture
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per turn create a 4-tile cataclysm zone (earthquake, storm, or fire — choose when cast) as the Shattered Seal weeps — enemies inside take 2d6 damage each round and suffer −10% saves; allies inside gain +5% DR and cannot be knocked prone by the zone; difficult terrain spreads 1 tile outward each round and structures inside may crack (DM discretion). After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

card.name: Slumber Glimpse
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and takes -2 on its next initiative adjustment or initiative check before the end of the encounter. The next attack against it before the end of its next turn gains +2 to hit. On a target already protected by the hard-control guard, failure instead removes Reactions and reduces Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Slumber Glimpse
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as they stagger through a waking dream; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the dream passes, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

card.name: Resonant Seed
card.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
card.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

card.name: Moment's Pause
card.duration: Until end of target's next turn
card.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and is treated as acting one initiative step later for the next round only. If the target has already suffered a full-turn denial from you this encounter, failure instead removes its Reaction and reduces its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Moment's Pause
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as time snags around them; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative until end of next round and cannot take reactions until the pause resolves.

card.name: The Spiral Opens
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; one known beneficial Time Revelation or one enemy within 5 tiles
card.effect: For 3 rounds, at the start of each of your regular turns choose ONE temporal option, each usable at most once during this Final. ECHO REVELATION: repeat only the immediate numeric damage, healing, movement or buff component of one beneficial Time Revelation you personally resolved during the previous round, paying 0 RC; this copy is not a new Revelation cast, copies no resource restoration, action grant, hard control, condition trigger, Prophecy Trigger or proc. FORCED ECHO: choose one non-player enemy within 5 tiles and one ordinary weapon attack or non-resource movement action it took during its previous turn. The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure, during its next turn it must repeat that action pattern if legally possible, but it chooses all legal targets and paths; it spends no limited resources and cannot be forced to harm itself. A player-controlled creature instead, on a failed save, loses its Reaction and must choose either repeat one ordinary non-resource action type from its prior turn or have Speed reduced to 0 until turn end. Allies retain memory of all temporal echoes. This Final never creates more than one additional full Action for any creature in a round. There are only two options in this Final; after using both once, remaining rounds provide only the printed temporal presence, without another echo. An echoed healing amount also pays 1 RC or consumes an unused per-rest healing use; a temporal copy cannot create an uncosted healing reserve.
card.prerequisite: Oracle 20; Mystery: Time

value.name: The Spiral Opens
value.description: Once per day, open a causality spiral for 3 rounds: at start of each round, choose one — repeat last round's beneficial Revelation at no cost, or force one enemy to repeat their last turn's worst action against their allies. Allies remember all timelines.

card.name: Black Manifestation
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
card.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 20; selected Oathbreaker inversion

card.name: Law's Weight
card.effect: A hostile creature is considered a source-qualified law breaker only if it knowingly lied while inside your Aura of Authority earlier this encounter. When such a creature enters or starts its turn in the zone, it makes a Charisma save. On failure its Speed is halved, AC is reduced by 2 and it cannot benefit from Dash or Haste-like extra movement until the start of its next turn. It saves again each turn while affected.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 9; Oath of Dominion

value.spell: Law's Weight — 20-ft zone for 3 rounds; lawbreakers (those who lied in your aura this combat) save or half speed, −2 AC, and cannot benefit from haste or dash until zone ends

card.name: Decree of Submission
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet that can hear you
card.effect: Choose Sub mission or Dread. The target makes a Wisdom save; a source-qualified law breaker has disadvantage on the initial save. Sub mission: on failure the target is Charmed by you and you state one simple command from Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. On its first affected turn it follows that command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one ordinary Action, then repeats the save at turn end. Dread: on failure it is Frightened of you and cannot willingly approach you, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Either mode ends on a successful repeat save. Player-controlled targets retain target choice, may never be commanded to self-harm, and cannot be forced to change beliefs or permanent allegiance. Spending that Action uses the hard-denial allowance. On later turns the effect only imposes Charmed and, on a failed repeat save, no Reactions and half Speed until the next turn; it cannot command another Action.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 13; Oath of Dominion

value.spell: Decree of Submission — 30-ft command; target save or charmed (obey one command) or frightened (cannot approach you) for 1 minute; oath-breakers have disadvantage

card.name: Echo of Ages
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.effect: Selected allies have advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened. When a selected hostile fey or elemental first enters your aura or is selected there, it makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot make attacks until the end of its next turn, though it may move, Dodge, Disengage, manipulate objects or use non-attack abilities. After suffering this attack denial once from you in the encounter, later failed saves instead remove its Reaction and reduce Speed by half until the end of its next turn.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 9; Oath of the Ancients

value.spell: Echo of Ages — you and allies in aura gain advantage on saves vs charm and frightened for 1 minute; fey and elementals that fail a Wis save when entering aura hesitate and cannot attack until end of next turn

card.name: Standing Stone
card.effect: The zone is difficult terrain for enemies and normal terrain for allies you choose when casting. At the start of each hostile fey or elemental's turn in the zone, it makes a Strength save. On failure its Speed is halved until the start of its next turn. It saves again each turn; no creature loses Actions or Reactions solely from Standing Stone.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 13; Oath of the Ancients

value.spell: Standing Stone — 20-ft zone of difficult terrain for enemies for 3 rounds; fey and elementals save or are slowed; allies treat zone as normal terrain

card.name: Iron Leash Aura
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen enemies in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: A selected enemy has Speed reduced by 10 feet, minimum 5 feet. The first time each round it willingly moves farther from you, it makes a Strength save; on failure its movement ends after 5 feet of that movement. This does not remove Actions or prevent forced movement.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Chain

originalObjects.value: Iron Leash — slow and control debuffs

card.displayPath: Shackled Lord — Oath of the Chain Oathbreaker

card.name: Reign of Ashes
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; ash bonds until end of next turn
card.effect: Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2 S d6 fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing target becomes ash-bound until the end of its next turn: Speed is halved and it cannot benefit from Dash or teleportation. It retains its Action and Reaction unless another feature removes them.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 11; Oathbreaker — Oath of Chains Broken

originalObjects.value: Reign of Ashes — chaotic fire that traps foes

card.displayPath: Unbound Flame — Oath of Chains Broken Oathbreaker

card.name: Royal Decree
card.rangeAndTarget: One hearing creature within 30 feet; three selected aura allies
card.duration: Until end of target’s next turn
card.effect: Target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it chooses to kneel Prone or move toward you by the safest route using up to its normal Speed on its next turn. It retains its Action and chooses its targets. No self-harm or hazardous route is required. Three chosen allies in your aura gain +1 on morale checks and saves against Frightened until the end of your next turn.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 5; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Royal Decree — command one creature within 30 ft; on failed Wis save it kneels prone or moves up to its speed toward you; allies in aura gain +1 to morale saves until end of next turn

card.name: Elemental Affinity
card.effect: Choose Fire: first fire technique hit/turn adds 1 damage; Ice: first cold damage target/turn loses 5 ft Speed until end next turn; Air:+5 ft Speed; Earth:+1 on STR/CON saves against forced movement. These are alternatives, not cumulative affinities.

source.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose an element (Fire, Ice, Air, or Earth) that enhances your abilities.

card.name: Elemental Chorus
card.rangeAndTarget: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

source.originalText: Elemental Chorus: Ultimate ability that summons all four elemental types around a zone for massive combined effect.

card.name: Balanced Elements
card.effect: Choose one application: add 1 damage to its next Burn tick OR extend a Speed reduction until end target's following turn. Never extends Stunned, silence, concentration duration or whole-Action denial.

source.originalText: Balanced Elements: Your elemental effects last longer and have secondary effects.

card.name: Vein Cutter
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemy critically hit by your weapon
card.effect: Consume prepared poison without its normal recipe effect; target CON save or Bleed 1d4 next 2 turns, Speed-10 ft and-1 next attack damage. Reapplication refreshes; source stack 3 replaced by one bounded package.

source.originalText: Vein Cutter: On critical hit, apply Bleed, Slow, and Weakened effects that can stack up to 3 times.

card.name: Crippling Lash
card.effect: Make one weapon attack. If it qualifies for Sneak, CON save or Speed-10 ft and-1 damage on next weapon hit for duration. No extra Sneak packet.

source.originalText: Crippling Lash: Your Sneak Attack slows the target and reduces their damage by -1 for 2 rounds.

card.name: Brutal Strike
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature within your weapon reach
card.duration: Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn
card.effect: Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.

source.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

card.name: Mutation Overload
card.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
card.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

card.name: Stonecore
card.effect: Gain +2 AC and immunity to forced movement or knockback from creatures no more than one size larger. Side effect: Speed -10 feet. Serum Tolerance suppresses the Speed penalty.
card.prerequisite: Prepared serum dose

source.originalText: | Stonecore | +2 AC | Immunity to knockback | 3 rounds | -15% Speed |

card.name: Hypermutation Spike
card.effect: When Butcherform Chassis activates, extend its maximum duration from 3 rounds to 5. During that activation you are immune to Stunned and your Speed cannot be reduced below half its normal value.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 16; Butcherform Chassis equipped; eligible feat grant

source.originalText: | Hypermutation Spike | Butcherform Chassis (Apex) | Once per long rest, extend Butcherform to 5 rounds and become immune to stun/slow during duration |
